name: @matatbread/matbot-storage-google-drive
description: Google Drive storage backend: document stores and file blobs persisted to a folder in the user's Google Drive, authenticated in-browser via Google Identity Services.

scripts.prepublishOnly: node -e "process.env.MATBOT_PUBLISH_ALL || (console.error('Refused: publish with pnpm publish-all from the repo root. It checks versions, contents and the web bundle first.'), process.exit(1))"
